caption:
Speed decides more deals than pitch quality ever will.

Not the price. Not the sales script. Not who's been doing this longer.

Independent analyses of B2B CRM data keep finding the same pattern: leads contacted within 5 minutes close at roughly double the rate of leads contacted a day later. Same offer, same reps, same product on both sides.

Across most industries, the average first response time still runs well past 24 hours. Fewer than one in four companies respond inside 5 minutes.

Test your own speed this week. Have a friend fill out your contact form or call your main line, then time the response. Anything past 5 minutes is real pipeline leaking out.

Our free Lead Response Audit scores your current speed and estimates what the delay is costing you.
